title: SimBrief Planned vs Actual Block Time
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simbrief:plan route_type=* block_delta_min=*
| stats avg(block_delta_min) as avg_block_delta_min, count as events by route_type
| sort - avg_block_delta_min
description: Shows average block-time delta minutes by route type for SimBrief plan accuracy.
value: Average block-time delta minutes by route type helps compare SimBrief plan accuracy across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `block_delta_min` on `simbrief:plan` events and normalize `route_type` so Splunk can summarize performance by route type.
visualization: Bar chart of average block-time delta minutes by route type.
grandmaExplanation: It lists the average block-time delta minutes for each route type so you can see what works best for SimBrief plan accuracy.
